parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the data plane cluster.

parameters.name: Continue
parameters.description: A pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. For the first call, leave this parameter empty. If the response includes a Continue value, more results are available. To get the next page, include the returned Continue value in your next request.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of waypoints to return.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the waypoint. If this parameter is left empty, all waypoints are returned. Otherwise, only the waypoint with the specified name is returned.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh instance.
